name: devbench-orchestrate
description: Autonomous backlog execution with LLM-as-judge review, guarded hooks, and the orchestrate skill. Ships the executor + review-team agents and the PreToolUse guard hooks that scope each agent's authority. Includes quota wait-and-resume on by default, operator-mode amendment, done-integrity guards, and backlog-assistant integration. Use during autonomous execution; pair with devbench-authoring during the planning phase.
